mapper.sql: id, task_type_key, status, priority, retry_count, worker_ip, callback_url, callback_status, progress, current_step_key, current_step_progress, steps_detail, payload, result, error_msg, created_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at, expired_at, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asts_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0 AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asts_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE asts_task SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, worker_ip = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < NOW() - (#{value} || ' seconds')::INTERVAL AND is_deleted = 0 RETURNING id
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.task_type_key, t.status, t.priority, t.retry_count, t.worker_ip, t.callback_url, t.callback_status, t.progress, t.current_step_key, t.current_step_progress, t.steps_detail, t.payload, t.result, t.error_msg, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.expired_at, t.is_deleted, c.type_name, c.exec_timeout_sec as timeout_seconds FROM asts_task t LEFT JOIN asts_task_type_config c ON t.task_type_key = c.type_key AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asts_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0 AND expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE asts_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = 'Task expired', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0 AND expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
WITH locked_task AS ( SELECT id FROM asts_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND task_type_key = #{taskType} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY
created_at ASC, priority DESC
priority DESC, created_at ASC
LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE asts_task t SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_ip = #{workerIp}::inet, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM locked_task WHERE t.id = locked_task.id RETURNING t.*
mapper.update: UPDATE asts_task SET current_step_key = #{currentStepKey}, current_step_progress = #{stepProgress}, steps_detail = #{stepsDetail}::jsonb, progress = #{globalProgress}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE asts_task SET status = #{status}, result = COALESCE(#{result}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), error_msg = COALESCE(#{errorMsg}, ''), progress = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SUCCESS' THEN 100 WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' THEN progress WHEN #{status} = 'CANCELLED' THEN progress ELSE progress END, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND (status = 'RUNNING' OR status = 'CANCELLING') AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE asts_task SET callback_status = #{callbackStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asts_task ( id, task_type_key, status, priority, retry_count, worker_ip, callback_url, callback_status, progress, current_step_key, current_step_progress, steps_detail, payload, result, error_msg, created_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at, expired_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{task.id}, #{task.taskTypeKey}, #{task.status}, #{task.priority}, #{task.retryCount}, #{task.workerIp}::inet, #{task.callbackUrl}, #{task.callbackStatus}, #{task.progress}, #{task.currentStepKey}, #{task.currentStepProgress}, '[]'::jsonb, #{payloadJson}::jsonb, #{resultJson}::jsonb, #{task.errorMsg}, #{task.createdAt}, #{task.updatedAt}, #{task.startedAt}, #{task.finishedAt}, #{task.expiredAt}, #{task.isDeleted} )
